visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short black hair and glasses, wearing a black collared shirt, stands in a studio setting. He gesticulates broadly with his hands to emphasize his energetic speech. The background features a vivid night-time cityscape of Taipei with the illuminated Taipei 101 tower clearly visible. The lighting is bright and professional, focused on the presenter. (2) A humorous meme of a black cat staring blankly with a digital loading symbol superimposed on its forehead appears briefly over the cityscape. The man continues his presentation in the foreground, his hands moving frequently as he speaks. The composition remains centered on his upper body and head. (3) Transitioning to a digital visualization, the frame is filled with a vast starry galaxy and colorful 3D molecular ball-and-stick models swirling in a dark space. The presenter remains in the foreground, pointing toward the floating graphics to explain the complexity of chemical molecules. The studio lighting remains consistent. (4) An animated sequence shows a CGI skeleton sitting at a wooden desk in a dimly lit, library-like room. The skeleton is looking at a thick open book next to a complex molecular model. The atmosphere is academic and slightly dark, with warm, localized lighting on the desk area. (5) A young woman dressed as a fictional character with long white hair in pigtails and round glasses is shown in a rustic indoor setting. She holds a large wooden staff and looks at the camera. The lighting is soft and natural, suggesting an indoor daylight environment. (6) Two scientists, a man and a woman in white lab coats, are seen in a clean laboratory environment. They are looking closely at a small green electronic circuit board under a desk lamp. The background shows blurred lab equipment and computer monitors. (7) A technical infographic titled "MACHINE LEARNING" and "NVIDIA cuML" is displayed on a light background. It includes icons for classification, regression, and clustering, as well as diagrams for CPUs and GPUs. The layout is clean, modern, and highly legible. (8) A large-scale data visualization map appears, showing thousands of purple and yellow dots representing molecular structures. The dots are clustered into star-like formations against a dark background, resembling a cosmic map or a complex social network diagram. The man's hands are visible at the bottom. (9) A person in professional attire is shown in an office setting, working on dual computer monitors. The screens display intricate node-link diagrams and network graphs. The lighting is standard office lighting with visible desk peripherals like a keyboard and mouse. (10) A high-detail animation of a small white robot with blue glowing eyes and circular joints walks through a virtual 3D grid space. The robot moves fluidly across the screen. The background is a clean, gray digital environment with soft, ambient virtual lighting. (11) A composite screen displays multiple professional portraits of instructors for the NVIDIA DLI courses. Each photo is accompanied by Chinese text describing their academic and professional credentials. The layout is informative and structured, similar to an online course catalog. (12) The main male presenter reappears in the night city studio, gesturing toward a Google search bar overlay at the bottom of the frame. The bar has the Chinese text "麗臺科技" typed into the search field. He maintains enthusiastic eye contact and a smiling expression for the conclusion.

A driving electronic BGM with a tempo of approximately 128 BPM and a prominent kick drum beat provides a rhythmic foundation. (2) A sharp, short "pop" sound effect punctuates a transition in the speech. The BGM continues with its mid-tempo electronic synth texture and steady percussion, while the narrator maintains a fast but clear speech rate. (3) A distinct "whoosh" transition sound effect marks the shift to discussing the complexity of molecules. The narrator's pitch variability increases to emphasize the scale of the data. The acoustic environment is pristine studio quality. (4) A short female vocal segment is heard, delivered with a calm and slightly playful tone. Immediately afterward, the male narrator interjects with high intensity and vocal loudness, saying "這可不行!" to regain command of the narrative. (5) A digital UI "ding" or "bell" sound effect occurs as the focus shifts to technical collaborations with NVIDIA. The electronic BGM maintains its major-mode tonality with a consistent, pulsing synthesizer rhythm that stays under the narration. (6) A series of metallic percussive hits and transition SFX are used to emphasize specific course benefits. The narrator's speech density is high, covering technical details with very few structural pauses or hesitations. (7) A "riser" sound effect creates a sense of buildup toward the promotional call to action. The BGM complexity increases with additional synth layers. The spectral brightness is high, making the high frequencies of the SFX stand out. (8) The narrator concludes with a warm, friendly tone and a final promotional message. The electronic music begins a gradual fade-out, maintaining its beat until the final hard cut where all audio ceases abruptly.
